cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: You Handle the Impossible Part
cards.instruction: Make someone accept responsibility for the one part of the plan that cannot reasonably be done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've folded my programme like yours. Rehearsal done. You fold the moon for tonight's courtyard film; I'll switch off the lamps.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I folded it to fit my pocket. How am I supposed to fold the moon?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Programmes ready. Start with the crescent; it already has a crease.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll take the lamps. You handle the sky.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll do lamps, chairs and projector if you'll fold the moon. Shall I tell the audience to wait for your blackout?

reason: Replace managerial own-the-moon phrasing with the actual impossible task while preserving offered work and public responsibility pressure.
